subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. "Motevate".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Motevate"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Motivate"**.
 
• **Motivate** means to provide someone with a reason or incentive to do something or to inspire them to take action. (प्रेरित करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher's encouraging words were enough to motivate the students to perform well in the exam.
 
 
 
• The word **"Motevate"** does not exist in the English language and is simply a misspelling of the word "Motivate".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Nostalgia** (अतीत की याद): A sentimental longing or affection for the past, typically for a period or place with happy personal associations.

 
 
• **Example:** Listening to old songs often fills her with nostalgia for her childhood days.
 
 
 
• **Neutral** (तटस्थ): Not supporting or helping either side in a conflict or disagreement; impartial.
 
 
• **Example:** The judge must remain neutral during the trial to ensure fairness.
 
 
 
• **Mutual** (आपसी): Experienced or done by each of two or more parties towards the other(s); shared in common.
 
 
• **Example:** Their friendship is built on mutual respect and trust.
